deviations.description: ARCHITECTURE.md assumed webpack; Next.js 16 Turbopack deadlocks at optimization phase with @zama-fhe/relayer-sdk/web (1.2MB JS + 4.5MB WASM)
deviations.actual: Force webpack mode via `next build --webpack` CLI flag (discovered in Next.js 16 CLI source)
deviations.reason: Turbopack hangs at 0% CPU indefinitely; even dynamic imports don't help (module still traced)
deviations.impact: significant — build script must always use --webpack flag

deviations.component: frontend/lib/fhevm.ts — static import replaced with dynamic import
deviations.description: Static import of @zama-fhe/relayer-sdk/web kept it in the module graph even in Turbopack
deviations.actual: await import('@zama-fhe/relayer-sdk/web') inside async functions only; type-only import via Awaited<ReturnType<>>
deviations.reason: Prevents bundler from statically analyzing 4.5MB WASM module; needed for both Turbopack (DEV-013) and production safety
deviations.impact: none — SDK loaded at runtime only, identical behavior

deviations.description: Default `next build` uses Turbopack in Next.js 16; `turbopack: undefined` in config does not disable it
deviations.actual: Build script updated to `next build --webpack`; confirmed via Next.js CLI source showing explicit --webpack flag
deviations.reason: Next.js 16 ignores turbopack config key for disabling; only CLI flag works
deviations.impact: minor — build command documented in package.json scripts

deviations.description: ARCHITECTURE.md used `import { injected } from 'wagmi/connectors'` which pulls in wagmi's Tempo wallet connector bundle
deviations.actual: Changed to `import { injected } from 'wagmi'` — injected is re-exported from main wagmi index
deviations.reason: wagmi/connectors bundle includes @wagmi/core/dist/esm/tempo/Connectors.js which dynamically imports optional 'accounts' package; webpack fails on unresolved bare specifier
deviations.impact: none — injected() behavior identical from either import path
